purpose: Identifiable local crossed-grid pilot for the documented EMU-MPS per-step model Δt(N,χ) = α N²χ³ + β N³χ². This is a local RTX 5070 Ti adaptation, not Pasqal's A100 timing table.

source_programs.source_semantics: Exact reconstructed official pulse formulas; layout and configured bond are independent crossed factors.

quality.reference_validation: For each (family, layout, session), fixed chi=256 must have Fidelity >=0.9999 against fixed chi=512 before candidate cells are accepted.
quality.candidate_metric: Fidelity against the session's accepted fixed reference final state
quality.quality_clock: Reference state generation, capture and overlap are outside network-build/first/warm timing clocks.

measurement.pilot_promotion: A later three-session core may only use cells whose resource and quality rows are retained here. Timings from this pilot are not silently promoted.

analysis.fit_constraint: nonnegative least squares with residuals and unconstrained sign diagnostic reported
